text:
zoe: Quick sync — we need to lock the format for the May webinar by EOD today. Proposal: 'Microcase Webinar — 3 short customer stories + 10-min panel'. Audience: platform engineers + infra PMs. Thoughts?
alex_g: love the microcase idea. keeps churn high and easier to demo. who are the three customers?
priya: can pitch an AWS partner case, a fintech pilot (anonymized), and an internal Redwood case study. I can draft short abstracts. want <300 words each.
jun_ops: inbound routing suggestion — separate registration links per use case, map to marketing hub for lead scoring. I'll add tracking params. UTM plan?
zoe: @jun_ops yes, need UTMs + Slack routing. Our playbook: utm_campaign=webinar_microcase&utm_source=email&utm_medium=web. Also need nurture cadences per segment.
alex_g: speaker ops: record pre-roll 5 min demos, live Q&A. Rehearsal: 30 min with mics + stage cues. Can we do a minimal run-of-show snippet?
zoe: paste run-of-show:
```
00:00 - 00:02 Intro & agenda (zoe)
00:02 - 00:12 Case 1 demo + 2 Q (Customer A)
00:12 - 00:22 Case 2 demo + 2 Q (Customer B)
00:22 - 00:32 Case 3 demo + 2 Q (Internal)
00:32 - 00:40 Panel + open Q&A
00:40 - 00:45 Close + CTA
```
priya: abstract draft for Case 1: "How MerchantX reduced per-token cost 2.8x by batching & prefix caching" — I'll circulate full copy by 1600.
jun_ops: I'll create reg links w/ UTMs and set up inbound routing to /marketing/webinars and tag leads with "webinar:microcase". Also will add a hidden field for company size.
alex_g: should we include a 1-question live poll during Case 2 to boost engagement? quick yes/no about latency vs cost tradeoff.
zoe: yes. decision: recording style — local + cloud stream to preserve quality. @webinar-bot can ping speakers 24h prior and push rehearsal invites.
webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Speakers will get a 24h reminder and rehearsal invite — 1748742723.
zoe: ok locking this. Priya please push abstracts by 1700, Jun please prod reg links by 1800. Thanks :thumbsup:
